Description.SourceString: A temple, to a long forgotten god of man. This place is abandoned, fallen into ruin, with no remnants of who it was dedicated to before. Sometimes even places can die, as the last memories of their purpose fade into nothingness. Now, it has become the property of Death and he resides here on the edge of Fellhollow, waiting for someone that can assist him with his problems.
